report: gitea/go-gitea v1.25.5 batch 9 follow-up (Actions concurrency cluster)

not_affected.basis: Requires Actions workflow-level concurrency groups: at v1.25.5 the YAML `concurrency` key is not parsed (no Concurrency field or group handling in modules/actions, models/actions or services/actions), so an inserted fork run can never cancel a trusted in-progress run in a shared group; the OSV range (introduced 0, fixed 15b8a5805adf) reflects the 28.0.0 fix release, not the feature history.

Requires Actions run-level concurrency groups: at v1.25.5 no concurrency group is computed and no sibling run is cancelled, so a blocked fork job can never be moved to a terminal state by a later run and then revived by approval; the OSV range (introduced 0, fixed 15b8a5805adf) reflects the 28.0.0 fix release, not the feature history.

left_open.reason: The frozen Rerun/rerunJob (routers/web/repo/actions/view.go:401-502) does set jobs back to waiting without considering NeedApproval, but the fix (PR #39399, f44e64be8107) is expressed on the v28 services/actions/rerun.go `plan` structure, whose pre-image does not exist at v1.25.5, so the fix marker cannot be tied to the frozen file. Left open for a dedicated review.
